description: This file defines a React component named AttachmentsTab and related subcomponents for displaying and managing attachments within a trace viewer UI. It handles image previews, diffs, download links, and text attachments, integrating with the trace model context.

classes.name: ExpandableAttachment
classes.description: A React component for displaying an individual attachment, including support for text attachments with expandable view, download link, and loading state.

methods.name: attachmentURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for accessing an attachment, based on the trace model and attachment properties.

methods.name: downloadURL
methods.description: Constructs a download URL for an attachment, including appropriate query parameters.

methods.name: attachmentKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key for React list rendering based on attachment properties.
